item.title: Man dead in West Montgomery homicide
item.description: It happened around 1:55 p.m. Friday in the area of Old Selma Road and Alan Lane.

item.title: Man injured in criminal trespass incident in Auburn
item.description: The incident happened around 12:40 a.m. Saturday morning in the 200 block of South Donahue Drive.

item.title: Saint James holds dedication for student who passed in 2024
item.description: The Saint James community came together Saturday to honor a student who passed away 2 years ago.

item.title: Alabama tops Auburn on the road 96-92
item.description: Alabama defeats Auburn 96-92 at Neville Arena. Sports Director Lindsey Bonner takes a closer look at post game remarks from both Steven Pearl & Nate Oats.

item.title: Campbell’s 25 help Troy beat Akron 79-69
item.description: Cooper Campbell scored 25 points as Troy beat Akron 79-69 on Saturday.

item.title: Hundreds crowded Millbrook for the Mardi Gras festival and parade
item.description: The largest Mardi Gras celebration north of Mobile happened Saturday in Millbrook.

item.title: Two dead in Troy University police chase
item.description: It started around 1:48 a.m. Sunday on Elm Street near campus when an officer observed a car stopped.

item.title: The Montgomery Art Guild hosts their Members’ Show Sunday
item.description: The Montgomery Art Guild hosted their Annual Members' Show in Montgomery Sunday.

item.title: Auburn women lose sixth game in a row, falling to No. 5 LSU 77-44
item.description: Auburn's women's basketball team fell to No. 5 LSU 77-44 at Neville Arena, for the Tigers sixth loss in a row.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks pound New England Patriots 29-13 in Super Bowl LX
item.description: The “Dark Side” defense has carried Sam Darnold and the Seattle Seahawks to a Lombardi Trophy in Super Bowl LX.
